notes: Fixed the update that kept getting stuck: the page and its script are each cached for ten minutes by the site that hosts them, and while the page was being fetched fresh the script was not. The app therefore kept reporting the version from the old script while the release feed kept offering the new one — Update now landed back on the same version, every time.

The script now comes from a versioned address, so every release is a file the phone has never seen and cannot answer from its cache; the service worker also stopped trusting the browser cache for all of the app’s files, not only the page.
The Check for updates row can no longer sit on “Checking…” forever: ten seconds and it reports that there was no answer.
Settings → Updates now ends with Reload this page, which loads the app from a fresh address — there if a phone’s cache ever disagrees with the server again.
Nothing else changed — the time-zone chip, elevation, location, the level, the converter and its six categories, currency, GPS measuring, the AR range finder and permissions are exactly as they were.
